name: rag-lite
description: The ticket 8.8 retrieval-augmented-generation proof: a `retrieve` step queries the reference `pg_fulltext` retriever for the documents most relevant to a run param, then an `llm` step answers the question grounded in those documents and cites each by id. Data flows from retrieve to llm through 8.2 templating — `${{ steps.search.output.results }}` splices the ranked results (an array of {id, content, score, metadata}) into the prompt as compact JSON. It runs fully offline: the retriever is local Postgres full-text search over an ingested corpus, and the model is the deterministic mock (`mock/sim-1`), so the answer is reproducible with no API key and no network; swapping the model id to a real provider makes it a live RAG workflow unchanged.

config.prompt: Answer the question "${{ run.params.question }}" using only the retrieved documents below, and cite each claim with the document id it came from. Documents: ${{ steps.search.output.results }}
